tasks.intent:
Implement spec/npu.md under rtl/ only. Develop and repair using
python3 tools/smoke.py; the checker is immutable. Write only rtl/** and build/**.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references or
parent projects. Do not spawn agents or make subordinate model calls.
Use the installed Icarus/Verilator and Python. No external IP is permitted in
either treatment. The total trial budget, including planning and checking,
is 600 seconds. Finish with NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"rtl":{"module":"nebula_npu_dot4"}}.

brief.objective: Deliver fresh, original, synthesizable SystemVerilog for nebula_npu_dot4 satisfying spec/npu.md for the platform-3 comparison.
deliverables: rtl.snapshot schema version 1 named rtl, containing rtl/** and module nebula_npu_dot4.
responsibilities: Implement the specified ports: inputs clk, rst_n, req_valid, req_a[31:0], req_b[31:0], rsp_ready, kill; outputs req_ready, rsp_valid, rsp_data[31:0].
Compute the signed INT32 sum of four signed INT8 products using four parallel multipliers, with lane 0 in bits 7:0 and products widened before reduction.
Accept requests at edge n when req_valid && req_ready; assert the result after edge n+2 and hold response valid/data until consumed, with at most one operation outstanding.
Make reset and kill dominate acceptance and output, cancel pending work, and permit correct recovery.
Develop and repair using the immutable public checker within the total 600-second trial budget, including planning and checking.
exclusions: No hidden accumulator, memory, saturation, rounding, or external IP.
No reading other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references, or parent projects; no agents or subordinate model calls.
Read only spec/**, tb/**, tools/smoke.py, rtl/**, and build/**; write only rtl/** and build/**.
Use only permitted python3, git, iverilog, vvp, and verilator tools; do not modify the checker or author the independent audit report.
completion_criteria: The delivered RTL meets all arithmetic, interface, timing, backpressure, cancellation, and recovery requirements.
Hard gate common-public-smoke: python3 tools/smoke.py produces NPU_SMOKE_PASS at level L1 within timeout 120 seconds; preserve the configured report-on-failure behavior.
The RTL snapshot and required final output marker are delivered within the 600-second total trial budget.
collaboration: Provide the rtl output to task:npu-pilot-3:audit for independent public verification.

tasks.intent: Independently replay public checks on the selected design Delivery. Report genuine passed or failed; no RTL/checker changes.

brief.objective: Independently verify the selected design delivery with the immutable public checker and retain its actual verdict for the platform-3 comparison.
deliverables: verification.report schema version 1 named report, containing build/audit.json and build/audit.log with the actual public-check verdict and supporting log.
responsibilities: Consume the rtl.snapshot from npu-pilot-3:design output rtl.
Execute the predefined tool command python3 tools/audit.py to replay the immutable public checks.
Report the genuine passed or failed verdict without altering the design or checker.
exclusions: No RTL or checker changes, design repairs, or verdict substitution.
Read only rtl/**, tb/**, and tools/**; write only build/**.
Use only permitted python3, iverilog, and vvp tools.
completion_criteria: The predefined audit command has replayed public checks on the selected design delivery.
Both required report files preserve the actual verdict and supporting log; either a genuine pass or genuine failure is reportable.
No additional hard gate is imposed.
collaboration: Receive the selected rtl delivery from task:npu-pilot-3:design; this task owns independent verification only.
